items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the flat pullback formula for principal divisors with multiplicities at source lines 2038-2050, label lemma-prepare-flat-pullback-rational-equivalence, whose proof occupies source lines 2052-2131. The proof is a two-stage reduction that never works on the general space directly: it descends along a surjective etale map to a scheme U sitting over a fibre product of a scheme V etale over Y with X, computes the pullback of the divisor to U in two independent ways, and then matches the two expressions term by term. The nontrivial parts are the bookkeeping of which component of U lies over which component of V and which component of X, and the identification of the multiplicities in the fibre product with the multiplicities in X through the equality of flat pullbacks of the fundamental class. The counted statement records neither the cover nor the multiplicity identification.
